gen.title: How early saving helps pay for education

cards.stem: What action can help your savings grow even faster?
options: Increasing the compounding frequency
Keeping money in a non-interest account
Waiting longer to start saving
cards.quote: Increasing the compounding frequency or your interest rate or adding to your principal can help your savings grow even faster.

options: both the money you save and the interest you earn
only the fees charged by a lender
only the money borrowed from a bank
cards.quote: Compound interest is when you earn interest on both the money you save and the interest you earn.

cards.stem: When can your money grow faster from compound interest?
options: The sooner you start saving for post-secondary education
The later you start saving for other expenses
The less often you add to savings
cards.quote: The sooner you start saving for post-secondary education, the faster your money can grow from compound interest.

cards.stem: What is a good first step to help meet education costs?
options: research the potential costs for the education path you're considering
avoid looking up future education prices
borrow without planning for costs
cards.quote: To help meet these costs, a good place to start may be to research the potential costs for the education path you're considering.
